test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

My supplier told me that he could see sincerity in my eyes.

options.text: My supplier said to me, "I could see sincerity in my eyes."
My supplier said to me, "He can see sincerity in my eyes."
My supplier said to me, "I can see sincerity in your eyes."
My supplier said to me, "I could see sincerity in his eyes."

solution:
The correct answer is** 'My supplier said to me, "I can see sincerity in your eyes."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **indirect speech **and we need to convert it into **direct speech.**
 
• When we change **an indirect speech to direct speech**, we use the following rules - 
 
 
• The **reporting verb told **is changed to '**said to'**. 
 
• The **conjunction that **is replaced with **inverted commas ("...") **to show the direct speech. 
 
• A **comma (,) **is added before the direct speech part. 
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in *capital letter. *
 
• The **modal verb (could)** is changed to its **present tense form 'can'.** 
 
• The **pronoun he **is changed from **second person **to **first-person 'I'. **
 
 
 
• So, by following the above rules, we get the direct speech as - My supplier said to me, "I can see sincerity in your eyes."
 
• Thus, **option 3 **is the correct answer.
